Summary
1732E ArmorBlock
®
- Multiple Vulnerabilities
The security of our products is important to us as your industrial automation supplier. This security issue was found internally during routine testing and is being reported based on our commitment to customer transparency and improvement of all business environments.
Product Description
The 1732E ArmorBlock® I/O is an on-machine distributed I/O module designed for rugged industrial environments, providing configurable digital and analog I/O with EtherNet/IP connectivity and an integrated webserver for device configuration and management.

Category
Details
CVE ID

Impact
A security issue exists within 1732E ArmorBlock® I/O , where an unauthenticated attacker can change the device's webserver password without valid credentials. This could result in admin account takeover or unauthorized modification of device configuration.
CVSS 3.1 Base Score
9.1/10
CVSS 4.0 Base Score
8.8/10
CWE
CWE-294 Authentication Bypass by Capture-replay
Known Exploited Vulnerability

Security Issue Details for CVE-2026-12656
Category
Details
CVE ID
CVE-2026-12656
Impact
A denial-of-service security issue exists in the affected product and version. The security issue stems from improper handling of network storm traffic, which can interrupt communication, cause device faults, and affect open TCP and UDP ports. A power cycle is required to recover the device to its normal state.
CVSS 3.1 Base Score
7.5/10
CVSS 4.0 Base Score
8.7/10
CWE
CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

security best practices
